# ImpulseLog

> ImpulseLog is an iPhone app that helps people pause impulse purchases, log resisted purchases and almost-buys, spot spending patterns, and build savings habits through wait timers, goals, streaks, and ADHD-friendly gamification.

ImpulseLog is a financial wellness and behavior-change tool. It is not a bank, budgeting service, financial adviser, or medical service.

## Product facts

- Platform: iPhone with iOS 17 or later.
- Core workflow: log an almost-buy, pause an unsure purchase, or record an intentional purchase.
- Free features: saved, bought, and pending decision logging; Impulse Rescue and wait timers; reusable shopping lists and sessions; optional mood, place, notes, and categories; goals, milestones, streaks, XP, and challenges; 7-day and 4-week Insights; 14-day mood history; one personalized Coach sample after enough completed decisions; widgets; Share to Pause; offline-friendly logging; and CSV/JSON export.
- Optional Premium: $4.99 per month or $29.99 per year in the US App Store, with local pricing shown before purchase.
- Premium features: fresh weekly Coach reviews with a practical next step and optional check-in; saved review and check-in history; deeper Coach pattern reviews; 6-month and all-time comparisons; up to one year of mood history; and deeper mood, place, category, and impulse patterns.
- Privacy position: no advertising inside the app and no sale of personal data.
